3.4.4
Operation and Maintenance of Utility Services
The government may undertake works for operation, maintenance, development or
execution of any of the following utility services without requiring obtaining permit from
the Building Official.
(a) Railways
(b) National Highways
(c) National Waterways
(d) National Gas grid
(e) National Power grid
(f) Major Ports
(g) Airways and Aerodromes
